entities.summary: Vicente Bokalic Iglic, C.M. is an Argentine Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Santiago del Estero from 2013 to 2024, and became archbishop when the diocese became an archdiocese in 2024. The same year, he was given the title "Primate of Argentina". Iglic was made a cardinal in 2024. He was previously an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Buenos Aires from 2010 to 2013 under Cardinal Jorge Bergoglio, the future Pope Francis. He is a member of the Congregation of the Mission.
